CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dashboard.slack_deliveries sdl WHERE sdl.incident_id = q.incident_id AND sdl.zeekad_message_version IS NOT NULL AND sdl.zeekad_message_version NOT LIKE 'status:%' ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS alerted FROM dashboard.incident_queue q LEFT JOIN dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq ON lq.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_status s ON s.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_reports self_r ON self_r.job_id = q.job_id AND self_r.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_reports r ON r.job_id = COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AND r.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.send_decisions d ON d.job_id = COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AND d.incident_id = q.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.analyst_review_queue arq ON arq.job_id = COALESCE(lq.zeekad_report_job_id, self_r.job_id) AND arq.incident_id = q.incident_id

SELECT job_id, incident_id, zeekad_message_kind, zeekad_message_version, zeekad_delivery_mode, zeekad_delivery_status, slack_payload, slack_ts, delivered_at, error, created_at, zeekad_thread_parent, zeekad_reply_broadcast FROM dashboard.slack_deliveries WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, job_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(lq.job_id, a.job_id) AS job_id, a.job_id AS review_job_id, COALESCE(lq.capture_id, j.capture_id) AS capture_id, a.incident_id, COALESCE(lq.queue_rank, a.queue_rank) AS queue_rank, COALESCE(lq.host_ip, a.host_ip) AS host_ip, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_role, a.zeekad_role) AS zeekad_role, a.zeekad_review_reason, a.requested_at, a.zeekad_review_action, a.analyst, a.decided_at, a.zeekad_review_resumed_at, a.zeekad_review_resume_failed FROM dashboard.analyst_review_queue a LEFT JOIN dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq ON lq.incident_id = a.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = a.job_id
AND (lq.incident_id IS NULL OR a.job_id = lq.zeekad_report_job_id) AND (lq.incident_id IS NOT NULL OR a.job_id = ( SELECT MAX(a2.job_id) FROM dashboard.analyst_review_queue a2 WHERE a2.incident_id = a.incident_id ))
AND COALESCE(lq.capture_id, j.capture_id) = #{captureId}
AND a.zeekad_review_action IS NULL
ORDER BY a.requested_at DESC, COALESCE(lq.job_id, a.job_id) DESC, COALESCE(lq.queue_rank, a.queue_rank) ASC

SELECT a.job_id AS job_id, a.job_id AS review_job_id, j.capture_id AS capture_id, a.incident_id, a.queue_rank, a.host_ip, a.zeekad_role, a.zeekad_review_reason, a.requested_at, a.zeekad_review_action, a.analyst, a.decided_at, a.zeekad_review_resumed_at, a.zeekad_review_resume_failed FROM dashboard.analyst_review_queue a LEFT JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = a.job_id WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.incident_id = #{incidentId} LIMIT 1

/* unifiedQueueBase */ SELECT p.*, CASE p.priority WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'low' THEN 2 END AS priority_order FROM ( SELECT lq.job_id, lq.capture_id, lq.bundle_id, lq.queue_rank, lq.incident_id, lq.host_ip, lq.zeekad_role, lq.event_start, lq.event_end, lq.zeekad_picked_by, lq.zeekad_also_flagged_by, lq.connection_count, lq.host_name, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_status, 'open') AS zeekad_status, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(lq.zeekad_status, '')) = '' THEN 'open' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(lq.zeekad_status)) END AS status_norm, lq.zeekad_resolution, lq.status_updated_at, lq.zeekad_report_job_id, CASE WHEN lq.zeekad_report_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_report, lq.zeekad_report_kind, r.zeekad_verification_passed, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_would_send, FALSE) AS zeekad_would_send, lq.zeekad_review_action, COALESCE(lq.zeekad_review_pending, FALSE) AS zeekad_review_pending,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dashboard.slack_deliveries sdl WHERE sdl.incident_id = lq.incident_id AND sdl.zeekad_message_version IS NOT NULL AND sdl.zeekad_message_version NOT LIKE 'status:%' ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS alerted, fs.detected_at, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(lq.zeekad_status, ''))) = 'closed' THEN NULL WHEN COALESCE(lq.zeekad_would_send, FALSE) = TRUE OR COALESCE(lq.zeekad_review_pending, FALSE) = TRUE THEN 'high' WHEN COALESCE(CARDINALITY(lq.zeekad_also_flagged_by), 0) >= 1 OR lq.zeekad_report_job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS priority,
CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(lq.zeekad_status, '')) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(lq.zeekad_status)) = 'open' THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(TRIM(lq.zeekad_status)) = 'investigating' THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(TRIM(lq.zeekad_status)) = 'closed' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS status_order FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.incident_id, MIN(j.finished_at) AS detected_at FROM dashboard.incident_queue q JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = q.job_id AND j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.finished_at IS NOT NULL WHERE q.capture_id IN GROUP BY q.incident_id ) fs ON fs.incident_id = lq.incident_id LEFT JOIN dashboard.incident_reports r ON r.job_id = lq.zeekad_report_job_id AND r.incident_id = lq.incident_id WHERE lq.capture_id IN ) p
OFFSET 0 ROWS

choose.when: (b.status_norm = 'open' AND b.detected_at IS NOT NULL AND b.capture_id IN #{lid} AND ((b.priority = 'high' AND b.detected_at < #{c.ackHighBefore}) OR (b.priority = 'medium' AND b.detected_at < #{c.ackMediumBefore}) OR (b.priority = 'low' AND b.detected_at < #{c.ackLowBefore})))

ORDER BY
b.detected_at ASC NULLS LAST, b.detected_at DESC NULLS LAST,
b.event_start ASC NULLS LAST, b.event_start DESC NULLS LAST, b.detected_at DESC NULLS LAST,
b.connection_count ASC NULLS LAST, b.connection_count DESC NULLS LAST, b.detected_at DESC NULLS LAST,
b.status_order ASC NULLS LAST, b.status_order DESC NULLS LAST, b.detected_at DESC NULLS LAST,
b.priority_order ASC NULLS LAST, b.priority_order DESC NULLS LAST, b.detected_at DESC NULLS LAST,
b.capture_id ASC, b.queue_rank ASC
mapper.select:
WITH g AS ( SELECT b.job_id, b.capture_id, b.bundle_id, b.queue_rank, b.incident_id, b.host_ip, b.zeekad_role, b.event_start, b.event_end, b.zeekad_picked_by, b.zeekad_also_flagged_by, b.connection_count, b.zeekad_status, b.status_norm, b.zeekad_resolution, b.status_updated_at, b.zeekad_report_job_id, b.has_report, b.zeekad_report_kind, b.zeekad_verification_passed, b.zeekad_would_send, b.zeekad_review_action, b.zeekad_review_pending, b.alerted, b.detected_at, b.priority, b.priority_order, b.status_order, CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_period, CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_strip FROM () b
), agg AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.in_strip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS page_total, COALESCE(SUM(b.in_strip), 0) AS page_total_all, MAX(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.in_strip = 1 THEN b.detected_at END) AS page_latest_detected_at,
MAX(CASE WHEN b.in_strip = 1 AND b.detected_at <= #{c.detectedAfter} THEN b.detected_at END)
CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS page_newest_before_period, COALESCE(SUM(b.in_period), 0) AS sum_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.priority = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_high, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.priority = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_medium, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.priority = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_low, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.zeekad_review_pending = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_review_pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.alerted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_alerted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.status_order = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_status_open, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.status_order = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_status_investigating, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.status_order = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_status_closed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND b.status_order = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_status_other, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.in_period = 1 AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sum_overdue FROM g b ), pg AS ( SELECT p0.*, LEAST(CAST(#{page} AS BIGINT), p0.page_count) AS page_no FROM ( SELECT a.*, GREATEST(1, (a.page_total + CAST(#{size} AS BIGINT) - 1) / CAST(#{size} AS BIGINT)) AS page_count FROM agg a ) p0 ), ranked AS ( SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS queue_pos FROM g b WHERE b.in_period = 1 AND b.in_strip = 1 ) SELECT a.page_total, a.page_total_all, a.page_latest_detected_at, a.page_newest_before_period, a.page_count, a.page_no, a.sum_total, a.sum_high, a.sum_medium, a.sum_low, a.sum_review_pending, a.sum_alerted, a.sum_status_open, a.sum_status_investigating, a.sum_status_closed, a.sum_status_other, a.sum_overdue, r.job_id, r.capture_id, r.bundle_id, r.queue_rank, r.incident_id, r.host_ip, r.zeekad_role, r.event_start, r.event_end, r.zeekad_picked_by, r.zeekad_also_flagged_by, r.connection_count, (SELECT h.host_name FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue h WHERE h.job_id = r.job_id AND h.incident_id = r.incident_id AND h.queue_rank = r.queue_rank LIMIT 1) AS host_name, r.zeekad_status, r.zeekad_resolution, r.status_updated_at, r.zeekad_report_job_id, r.has_report, r.zeekad_report_kind, r.zeekad_verification_passed, r.zeekad_would_send, r.zeekad_review_action, r.zeekad_review_pending, r.alerted, r.detected_at, r.priority FROM pg a LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.queue_pos > (a.page_no - 1) * CAST(#{size} AS BIGINT) AND r.queue_pos <= a.page_no * CAST(#{size} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY r.queue_pos
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () b

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN b.priority = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high, SUM(CASE WHEN b.priority = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium, SUM(CASE WHEN b.priority = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low, SUM(CASE WHEN b.zeekad_review_pending = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS review_pending, SUM(CASE WHEN b.alerted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alerted, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status_order = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_open, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status_order = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_investigating, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status_order = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_closed, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status_order = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_other, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue FROM () b
SELECT MAX(b.detected_at) FROM () b

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.detected_at > #{after} AND b.detected_at <= #{until} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_period, COUNT(*) AS total_all, MAX(CASE WHEN b.detected_at > #{after} AND b.detected_at <= #{until} THEN b.detected_at END) AS latest_in_period, MAX(CASE WHEN b.detected_at <= #{after} THEN b.detected_at END) AS newest_before_period FROM () b

SELECT lq.capture_id, MAX(fs.detected_at) AS last_detected_at FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq JOIN ( SELECT q.incident_id, MIN(j.finished_at) AS detected_at FROM dashboard.incident_queue q JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = q.job_id AND j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.finished_at IS NOT NULL WHERE q.capture_id IN #{cid} GROUP BY q.incident_id ) fs ON fs.incident_id = lq.incident_id WHERE lq.capture_id IN #{cid} GROUP BY lq.capture_id
SELECT MAX(finished_at) FROM dashboard.scoring_jobs WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND capture_id IN #{cid}

SELECT j.capture_id, MAX(j.job_id) AS latest_job_id, (SELECT MAX(lq.event_end) FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq WHERE lq.capture_id = j.capture_id) AS max_event_end FROM dashboard.scoring_jobs j WHERE j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.capture_id IN #{cid} GROUP BY j.capture_id
SELECT DISTINCT zeekad_picked_by FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue WHERE zeekad_picked_by IS NOT NULL AND capture_id IN #{cid} ORDER BY zeekad_picked_by ASC
SELECT DISTINCT zeekad_role FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue WHERE zeekad_role IS NOT NULL AND capture_id IN #{cid} ORDER BY zeekad_role ASC

SELECT b.incident_id, b.capture_id, b.event_start, b.detected_at, b.status_norm, b.priority, h.ack_at, b.status_updated_at, b.zeekad_resolution FROM () b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sh.incident_id, MIN(sh.changed_at) AS ack_at FROM dashboard.incident_status_history sh WHERE LOWER(TRIM(sh.to_status)) = 'investigating' GROUP BY sh.incident_id ) h ON h.incident_id = b.incident_id
WHERE b.status_order IN (0, 1) OR b.detected_at > #{after} OR h.ack_at > #{after} OR (b.status_norm = 'closed' AND b.status_updated_at > #{after})
SELECT b.capture_id, b.detected_at, b.priority, b.alerted, b.incident_id, b.host_ip, b.zeekad_role FROM () b

SELECT j.capture_id, MAX(CASE WHEN j.status IN ('succeeded', 'failed') THEN j.job_id END) AS latest_ended_job_id, MAX(CASE WHEN j.status = 'succeeded' THEN j.job_id END) AS latest_succeeded_job_id, SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'failed' AND COALESCE(j.finished_at, j.started_at) > #{after} AND COALESCE(j.finished_at, j.started_at) <= #{until} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_in_period FROM dashboard.scoring_jobs j WHERE j.capture_id IN #{cid} GROUP BY j.capture_id
SELECT job_id, capture_id, bundle_id, status, started_at, finished_at, error, incident_count FROM dashboard.scoring_jobs WHERE job_id IN #{jid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dashboard.scoring_jobs j WHERE j.capture_id IN #{cid}

SELECT bundle_id, registry_name, registry_version, manifest_sha256, registered_at, thresholds FROM dashboard.model_bundles WHERE bundle_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT j.bundle_id FROM dashboard.scoring_jobs j WHERE j.capture_id IN #{cid} ) ORDER BY registered_at DESC, bundle_id ASC

SELECT lq.incident_id, lq.capture_id, fs.detected_at FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT q.capture_id, q.incident_id, MIN(j.finished_at) AS detected_at FROM dashboard.incident_queue q JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = q.job_id AND j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.finished_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.capture_id, q.incident_id ) fs ON fs.capture_id = lq.capture_id AND fs.incident_id = lq.incident_id

SELECT q.incident_id, MIN(q.capture_id) AS capture_id, MIN(j.finished_at) AS detected_at FROM dashboard.incident_queue q JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = q.job_id AND j.status = 'succeeded' WHERE q.incident_id = ANY(#{incidentIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}) GROUP BY q.incident_id
SELECT lq.job_id, lq.queue_rank FROM dashboard.latest_incident_queue lq WHERE lq.incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY lq.job_id DESC, lq.queue_rank ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.job_id, q.queue_rank FROM dashboard.incident_queue q JOIN dashboard.scoring_jobs j ON j.job_id = q.job_id AND j.status = 'succeeded' WHERE q.incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY q.job_id DESC, q.queue_rank ASC LIMIT 1
